summary: 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze. 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned. All 55 unlock in single player; there are no online trophies. Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase and PSNProfiles agree on all 55). Guides are written in our own words for this entry and cite their sources beside each trophy.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The last trophy you will earn. It pops the moment the other 54 are done, so there is nothing to do for this one directly: work the roadmap in order and it follows A Long Road. Expect around 200 hours in total; the story alone takes 50 to 60 hours.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. This is the first story trophy and it unlocks as you play: you cannot miss it. Keep playing through the opening and it pops when the mission ends.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. A story trophy, unmissable: it pops when the chapter ends. Before you leave Chapter 1, meditate at Lucia's balcony spot: it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and that spot is gone after this chapter.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. A story trophy, unmissable. Chapter 2 is where both Jason and Lucia become playable, which opens most of the side list: start stranger strands and activities once you are free to roam.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. A story trophy, unmissable. The robbery trophies start opening up in Chapter 3, so once the chapter ends you can begin the bank vault and armored truck runs.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. A story trophy, unmissable. By now most of Leonida is open: use the free-roam gaps between missions to work on exploration and collectibles.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission, the end of Chapter 5 and the story. Unmissable: it pops at the credits. Make a manual save before the final mission: with no mission replay in the game, that save is your safety net for anything story-adjacent you have not finished.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run. A story trophy, unmissable: it pops when the mission ends. Just keep playing the story in order.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist. A story trophy, unmissable. Guide sites place this heist in Chapter 3, so it comes as you work through the campaign.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play. A story trophy, unmissable: it pops when the mission ends, as part of the campaign.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners. A story trophy, unmissable: it pops when the mission ends, as part of the campaign.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown. A story trophy, unmissable. Guide sites place this takedown in Chapter 4, so it comes as you work through the campaign.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story trophy, unmissable: it pops when the mission ends, as part of the campaign.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion: the in-game checklist of 35 tasks covering the story, activities, collectibles and challenges. This is the hardest trophy and usually the last before the platinum. It pops the moment the checklist hits 100%, and the platinum follows at once. Work the roadmap in order and check the in-game completion list as you go, so nothing is left to guess at the end.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 achievements
Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts across Leonida: stunt jumps and unique stunts. Any stunt counts, so fold them into normal driving: jump ramps, catch air off hills and use fast cars on the highways. PSN tracks your count to 250.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: one round of every activity on the map. You do not need to win or finish them all, just try each type. Open the map and work through the activity icons one by one.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit every shooting range and gold each of its challenges: accuracy and speed both matter, so use a weapon you are comfortable with and replay a challenge until the gold medal lands. This is one of the harder silvers, so leave it for a focused session rather than rushing it.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Each venue has its own race and you only need one win per venue. Learn each course's line before pushing for the win, and tick venues off as you travel the map.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races: 20 distinct races, not the same one 20 times. Mix race types and venues across Leonida. PSN tracks distinct wins to 20, so vary the events you enter.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal and out-fish him in his challenge: watch the line tension and reel steadily rather than mashing, and keep the fish on the line until it is landed.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game: finish any game on any arcade cabinet. Pick the shortest cabinet you find and play it to the end. One finished game is all it takes.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand ends here: finish his missions in order and this pops after his last one. Side-character finals stay available, so you cannot lock yourself out, but do not leave them to the very end.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's strand in order and this pops after his last mission.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's strand in order and this pops after his last mission.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Stranger missions appear as icons across the state: take each strand to its end. Eight full strands are needed, so start them early and finish them as they appear instead of leaving them all for the end.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's strand in order and this pops after his last mission.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's strand in order and this pops after his last mission.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. This is the one trophy you can miss: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter, and the game has no mission replay, so meditate there before you finish Chapter 1. After that, work through the remaining spots as you explore. Several guides call this the only missable trophy in the game. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter as a safety net.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Complete Bret's hunt: track the unique animal he points you to and take it down. Bret's strand is one of the side-character lines, so follow his missions until the hunt is offered.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida: collect full sets and three completed sets pop the trophy. Check your collection often so you know which sets are close, and sweep the areas you have not fully searched.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 different locations. Open the WAiNK app whenever you reach a new spot: it is a check-in grind, so fold it into exploration and the 52-area sweep of Leonida.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the map's scattered objectives: clear any 50 of them. Save this for the cleanup stage, since most will fall out of normal play by then.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, reach a 4-star wanted level and then lose the cops and escape. Get the heat up together, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear: a fast car and the back roads help more than fighting it out.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Chain three shop robberies in a row: plan a route through three nearby shops and keep the wanted level alive between them. If the heat drops, the chain breaks and you start over.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles: get in or scan 100 different vehicles. Variety is the point, so try every vehicle type you see, from cars to boats and bikes. PSN tracks discoveries to 100.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Find a group of five, trigger Combat Focus, and line up the shots inside one window: a crowded firefight is the place to try it, and missing the fifth means trying again.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the Vice City airport: leave in a way no schedule covers. Steal a plane from the airport and take off, and the trophy pops once you are airborne and away.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description points at the Rhino tanks. Guide sites describe this as a Rhino-related challenge: find a Rhino, get behind its controls and put it to work in combat. The precise trigger is still being pinned down at launch, so treat this as one to try whenever a Rhino is in reach.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses. Plan the entry, move slowly, and get out before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails and you try again.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape: crack five vaults and get away each time. Vaults open up from Chapter 3. Plan each job and your getaway in advance, and the fifth escape pops the silver.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Hit an armored truck on the road, take its cash, then lose the pursuit: a fast getaway car matters more than the hit itself, so have your escape route planned before you strike.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: reveal every one of the 52 areas on the map. Drive, fly and sail into each region until the map is fully uncovered. PSN tracks areas to 52, so check the map for the blank corners you have not visited yet.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Hit one illegal operation per gang across the state: nine hits in total, one for every gang. Keep a note of which gangs you have hit so none is missed.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail at the spot with the view, and take it in. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed at launch: the description is the only hint so far, and guide sites list this among the trophies with no confirmed method yet.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a showroom window and out the other side. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed at launch: the description is the only hint so far, and guide sites list this among the trophies with no confirmed method yet.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a game of bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley: the trophy is about the follow-through, so finish your game there rather than walking out mid-frame.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Guide sites report this pops when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength, so train both characters' Strength to the top. The description is deliberately vague: treat the Strength reading as the current best report, not a certainty, and expect it to land during the campaign.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile: make choices across the game and the count climbs to 500. Guide sites warn not to push toward the Irredeemable profile, which is permanent, so check your Criminal Profile before going on a rampage.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. This is one of the vague story trophies: it points to a story moment and should pop while you play the campaign. No confirmed trigger exists yet at launch, and guide sites list it among the trophies with no confirmed method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? One of the vague story trophies: it points to a strange moment in the campaign and should pop as you play. No confirmed trigger exists yet at launch, and guide sites list it among the trophies with no confirmed method.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Take out a target with a melee drive-by: attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. The precise conditions are still being confirmed at launch, so try it on a slow-moving target beside the road.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies: launder them through your contacts and the total climbs to $250,000. This is a late-game money grind, so save it for after the big heists when the bills are piling up.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, food, weapons and anything else across Leonida's shops: spending counts everywhere, and $100,000 goes fast once you are buying cars and gear. It pairs naturally with the late-game money grind.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy every garage property on the map: you need the money first, so this is a late-game purchase. Check the property icons on the map to find the ones you are missing.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app and register ten different vehicles you own or find. It pairs well with the Whip It Good sweep of 100 vehicles.

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

roadmap.title: Play the story — Chapters 1 to 5
roadmap.text: Finish the campaign first. The chapter trophies, the named mission trophies and the five vague story trophies all land here, including the gold for the final mission. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission: the game has no mission replay.

roadmap.title: Side characters — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret
roadmap.text: Complete the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, plus Bret's unique animal hunt. These strands stay available, so work them as they appear.

roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks — 8 strands
roadmap.text: Finish eight full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Start them early; they are scattered across the state.

roadmap.title: Explore Leonida
roadmap.text: Reveal all 52 areas, meditate at all 18 spots and WAiNK It at 100 locations, and discover 100 vehicles. Do Lucia's Chapter 1 balcony meditation before Chapter 1 ends: it is the one missable spot.

roadmap.title: Races and stunts
roadmap.text: Win 20 different races, win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 venues, land 250 stunts, try all 9 activity types once, and beat Cal at fishing.

roadmap.title: Shooting and arcade
roadmap.text: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges, finish an arcade game, bowl at the Kolt & Associates alley, and land a melee drive-by.

roadmap.title: Robberies
roadmap.text: Rob 5 bank vaults, an armored truck and a jewelry store unseen, chain 3 shop robberies with your partner, hit one illegal operation per gang, and pull off the airport, Rhino and showroom stunts.

roadmap.title: Money and collectibles
roadmap.text: Complete 3 card sets, buy all 8 garages, register 10 vehicles with Scooter Bros, spend $100,000 across shops and launder $250,000 in Marked Bills.

roadmap.title: Cleanup and 100%
roadmap.text: Finish 50 challenges and push the in-game checklist to 100% for A Long Road. The platinum, Vice Got a Price!, pops the moment it does.

notes: There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus: keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission.
Cheats switch off trophies and saving, so leave them off on a trophy run.
All 55 trophies unlock in single player. There are no online trophies.

Five trophies have no confirmed unlock method at launch (In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin). Their guides say so plainly and give only what the official description implies.

Counts shown are the ones PlayStation tracks (PSNProfiles): 250 stunts, 42 Shooting Range challenges, 18 meditation spots, 52 areas, 100 WAiNK locations, 100 vehicles, 500 Criminal Profile actions, and the rest.
